id: title:adboio:attribute local pi costs to tasks

review.posthog_relevance: Adds task-specific identification to Desktop Pi RPC proxy URL construction, potentially supporting differentiated routing or session tracking for AI agent tasks.
review.reason: Adds a new parameter `taskId` to the `getProxyUrl` method and its callers, and changes the header record builder to accept scoped properties. This could support task-specific routing or identification in the downstream LLM gateway or authentication proxy, potentially distinguishing between different AI agent tasks or sessions.
review.uncertainty: The implementation demonstrates a structural change supporting task-specific identification, but the actual benefit, adoption, or operational necessity is not demonstrated by the code alone; this is a capability addition rather than a demonstrated systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new parameter `taskId` to the `getProxyUrl` method and its callers, and changes the header record builder to accept scoped properties.
observations.posthog_connection: The Desktop Pi RPC client factory now passes a task-specific ID into the proxy URL construction, which is then used to build a scoped property header record. This could support task-specific routing or identification in the downstream LLM gateway or authentication proxy, potentially distinguishing between different AI agent tasks or sessions.
